submission.justification: Absorber-F2 with 6mm plate thickness provides the best energy resolution of 3.313% at 100 GeV among all tested configurations. This represents a 13% improvement over the second-best option (F1 at 4mm with 3.819%) and a 36% improvement over F3. The simulation systematically tested all three candidate materials at thicknesses from 2-10mm in 2mm increments, confirming that F2 at 6mm is the optimal design point. All materials were found to be mechanically compatible with the detector design. This configuration meets all specified constraints while delivering superior performance for the primary goal of achieving the best possible energy resolution.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV
requirements.evidence: F2 at 6mm achieves 3.313% resolution, which is the best result across all materials (F1, F2, F3) and all thicknesses tested (2, 4, 6, 8, 10 mm). This is confirmed by best_resolution_overall=3.313 and optimal_material_code=2.
